samples.question: Panel A is the left histogram and panel B is the right histogram. Each has seven equal-width bins with visible integer count bars on one shared vertical scale. For each panel, compute the weighted mean bin number using bar counts, then subtract the median bin number, defined as the first bin whose cumulative count reaches at least half the total. Which panel has the larger mean-minus-median value? Choose A or B; ties and near ties are quarantined.
